Definition: {to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to arise, stand; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to arise from; 1a2) to come on the scene (fig); 1a3) to arise (out of inaction); 1a4) to stand; 1a5) to endure; 1b) (Pael) to set up, establish; 1c) (Aphel); 1c1) to set up; 1c2) to lift up; 1c3) to establish; 1c4) to appoint; 1d) (Hophal) to be made to stand
